items.title: Does Cintas (CTAS) Leave Enough Room For Its Cash Flow Story?
items.summary: Cintas has delivered a strong run in recent years, and with the share price recently closing at US$222.36, the key issue now is whether the underlying cash flows support that kind of market confidence. With the stock in focus after a major uniform rental merger announcement, investors are asking if the current valuation lines up with what the business can realistically generate in cash over time. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 112.0%, which puts a lot of weight on the question...
